title: To See is Not to Learn: Protecting Multimodal Data from Unauthorized Fine-Tuning of Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.14291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) is increasingly accompanied by unauthorized scraping and training on multimodal web data, posing copyright and privacy risks to data owners. Existing countermeasures, such as machine unlearning and watermarks, are inherently post-hoc approaches that act only after intellectual property infringement has already occurred. In this work, we propose MMGuard to empower data owners to proactively protect their multimodal data against unauthorized LVLM fine-tuning. MMGuard generates unlearnable examples by injecting human-imperceptible perturbations that exploit the learning dynamics of LVLMs. By minimizing the training loss, the perturbation creates an optimization shortcut, causing the model to overfit to the noise and thereby degrading downstream performance when the perturbation is absent during inference. translated_title: 看见并不等于学会：保护多模态数据免受大型视觉语言模型的未授权微调
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的快速发展伴随着对其多模态网络数据的未经授权抓取和训练，这给数据所有者带来了版权和隐私风险。现有的应对措施，如机器遗忘和水印技术，本质上都是事后方法，只能在知识产权侵权已经发生后才发挥作用。在这项工作中，我们提出了MMGuard，使数据所有者能够主动保护其多模态数据免受未经授权的LVLM微调。MMGuard通过注入人类无法察觉的扰动来生成不可学习的样本，这些扰动利用了LVLMs的学习动态。通过最小化训练损失，该扰动创建了一个优化捷径，导致模型过拟合于噪声，从而在推理阶段扰动不存在时降低模型的下游性能。为了进一步强化这种防御，MMGuard引入了跨模……
tldr: 提出MMGuard方法，通过注入利用LVLM学习动态的不可感知扰动生成“不可学习的多模态样本”，诱导模型过拟合于噪声，使数据所有者能够在侵权发生前主动保护多模态数据免受未经授权的模型微调。
en_tdlr: MMGuard proactively protects multimodal data from unauthorized LVLM fine-tuning by generating unlearnable examples with imperceptible perturbations that exploit LVLM learning dynamics, inducing overfitting to noise and degrading downstream inference performance.
